title: Nasdaq Futures Rally on Upbeat Amazon Earnings and Chip Stock Strength
excerpt: September Nasdaq 100 E-Mini futures (NQU26) are up +1.12% this morning as investors continued to pile back into AI-related stocks following upbeat earnings f...
content_html:
Oleksandr Pylypenko

Fri, July 31, 2026 at 6:42 AM EDT 10 min read

September Nasdaq 100 E-Mini futures (NQU26) are up +1.12% this morning as investors continued to pile back into AI-related stocks following upbeat earnings from tech giant Amazon.

Amazon.com (AMZN) jumped over +12% in pre-market trading after the company's cloud-computing unit, Amazon Web Services, recorded the fastest quarterly revenue growth since 2021. The revenue growth rate in the AWS segment was 37% in Q2, compared with Wall Street's expectations of 31%. Such a strong beat allowed investors to look past the company's $20 billion increase in full-year capex guidance.

Nasdaq 100 futures got a further boost from gains in chip and AI infrastructure stocks in pre-market trading after earnings from U.S. tech giants provided evidence that demand for components powering AI remains robust.

On the negative side, Apple (AAPL) slumped over -7% in pre-market trading after the iPhone maker provided FQ4 revenue growth guidance that fell short of analysts' expectations.

Meanwhile, the price of WTI crude edged higher on Friday as investors assessed the latest developments in the Middle East conflict. State-run IRIB News reported that six tankers were blocked in the Strait of Hormuz, citing a statement from the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

In yesterday's trading session, Wall Street's major indices ended in the green. Microsoft (MSFT) jumped over +15% and was the top percentage gainer on the Dow after the technology giant reported that revenue in its cloud-computing unit grew at the fastest pace in four years in FQ4, and Chief Financial Officer Amy Hood said she expected growth to accelerate further in the current quarter. Also, chip and AI infrastructure stocks rallied, with Sandisk (SNDK) soaring about +26% to lead gainers in the S&P 500 and Micron Technology (MU) surging more than +18%. In addition, Lam Research (LRCX) popped nearly +18% after the chip equipment maker posted upbeat FQ4 results and issued FQ1 guidance that smashed Wall Street's estimates. On the bearish side, Meta Platforms (META) slumped more than -7% after the social media giant gave a disappointing Q3 revenue forecast.

亚历山大·皮利宾科

2026 年 7 月 31 日星期五，美国东部时间上午 6:42 阅读 10 分钟

9 月纳斯达克 100 E-Mini 期货 (NQU26) 今天上午上涨了 1.12%，投资者在科技巨头亚马逊的乐观盈利之后继续涌入人工智能相关股票。

亚马逊 (AMZN) 的云计算部门亚马逊网络服务 (Amazon Web Services) 录得 2021 年以来最快的季度收入增长，该公司在盘前交易中股价上涨超过 12%。 第二季度AWS部门的收入增长率为37%，而华尔街的预期为31%。 如此强劲的表现让投资者忽略了该公司全年资本支出指引增加的 200 亿美元。

  • SpaceX IPO 将员工变成百万富翁几周后，员工透露蓝色起源股票一文不值
  • Nebius 股票再次获得华尔街评级。 这就是投资者关注的原因。
  • 亲爱的 Rivian Stock 粉丝，请在您的日历上标记 7 月 30 日
  • 市场变化很快。 请阅读我们的免费正午条形图简报时事通讯，了解独家图表、分析和头条新闻。

纳斯达克 100 指数期货在盘前交易中因芯片和人工智能基础设施股的上涨而进一步提振，此前美国科技巨头的财报证明对人工智能驱动组件的需求仍然强劲。

不利的一面是，苹果 (AAPL) 在 iPhone 制造商提供的第四季度收入增长指引未达到分析师预期后，在盘前交易中下跌超过 -7%。

与此同时，随着投资者评估中东冲突的最新进展，周五 WTI 原油价格小幅走高。 国营IRIB新闻援引伊斯兰革命卫队的声明报道称，六艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡被拦截。

昨天的交易时段，华尔街主要指数收盘上涨。 微软 (MSFT) 跃升超过 15%，成为道指涨幅最大的股票，此前这家科技巨头报告称，其云计算部门的收入在第四季度实现了四年来最快的增长，首席财务官艾米·胡德 (Amy Hood) 表示，她预计本季度的增长将进一步加速。 此外，芯片和人工智能基础设施股上涨，Sandisk (SNDK) 飙升约 26%，领涨标准普尔 500 指数，美光科技 (MU) 飙升超过 18%。 此外，芯片设备制造商 Lam Research (LRCX) 公布了乐观的第四季度业绩并发布了超出华尔街预期的第一季度指引，股价上涨近 18%。 悲观的一面是，社交媒体巨头 Meta Platforms (META) 给出了令人失望的第三季度收入预测，股价下跌超过-7%。
